brief:
Former military chief Gadi Eisenkot's Yashar party announced Tuesday it had agreed to a coalition pact with a right-wing opposition party, according to Al-Monitor. The agreement represents the first coalition accord in Eisenkot's bid to assemble a governing majority following last month's elections.

Details of the coalition terms and the identity of the partner party were not immediately disclosed. Eisenkot's efforts come as Israeli political parties negotiate post-election alliances needed to form a government.

title: Eisenkot's Yashar party secures first coalition agreement
